## Текущий обзор

[rurima-security-rootfs-audit-20261123](../../reviews/rurima/2026-11-23.md) — BOUNDED_CODE_REVIEW. Pinned README/FAQ/source C code, build/CI, Ruri README/USAGE/Security docs statically reviewed. ## Применимость к проектам

Перенесены явные документальные оценки. Это частичный охват проектов, не проверенный integration seam и не измеренная польза.

- [dsh-paper2agent](../../projects/dsh-paper2agent.md): DOCUMENTED_CANDIDATE; DOCUMENTED_CANDIDATE / NEEDS_EVIDENCE. Documentary architecture and rootfs-imaging comparison only; not a validated substitute for OCI-aware secure container execution or a verified source integration seam. Ограничения: The original project uses or references container integration, but Rurima supplies incomplete isolation, external dependencies and conditional image integrity. No verified performance, runtime security or existing deployment benefit. Следующий тест: A incumbent rootless Podman/Skopeo, B static Rurima path review, C only after owner security gate trusted synthetic rootfs extraction in separate disposable VM; compare exact content metadata/digests, network deny, file escape, CPU/RSS/IO and total maintenance cost. [Основание](../../portfolio/2026-11-23/rurima.md); предыдущая оценка: нет.
